items.title: All Sandbox runtimes now use Vercel Managed Images
items.summary: All  runtimes now use Vercel Managed Images (VMIs).Vercel SandboxLegacy runtimes, such as , now use the open-source images in the , distributed through Vercel Container Registry (VCR). Sandboxes created with these now come with 64 GB of storage and use the same infrastructure as sandboxes powered by VCR.node22vercel/sandbox repositoryThe universal image is released nightly, and rolling tags such as  pick up operating system, dependency, and coding agent updates. Pin an image digest when you need a reproducible environment.latestSandboxes created with version 3 or later of the JavaScript Sandbox SDK use  by default. The universal image includes Node.js, Python, coding agents such as Claude Code and Pi, and common utilities. You can pull it at .vercel/sandbox/universal:latestvcr.vercel.com/vercel/sandbox/universal:latestLearn more in the .Sandbox documentationRead more
